summary: Improve supply chain flow with DMAIC, process measures and practical exercises. Explore the five-day foundation course.
lede: Lean Six Sigma in supply chains is a structured method for reducing waste and process variation in purchasing, inventory, warehouse and delivery processes. For supply chain practitioners in warehouse, procurement and logistics roles, the course offers a practical way to investigate delays, errors and rework. You practise scoping processes with SIPOC, measuring performance, mapping flow, analyzing defects with Pareto and 5 Whys, selecting countermeasures and drafting control plans.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits you if your daily work touches supply chain processes and you need a practical way to identify and address avoidable delays, errors or rework.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with purchasing, inventory, warehousing or logistics workflows is useful. No prior Lean Six Sigma training or coding experience is required.
